summary: Replace the retired grouping-wording shell/Python gate with a Rust/Buck2 checker, wire tenant/RBAC packaging verification to Buck2, and reduce the audited non-vendored Python/shell surface from 55 to 53.
claim_boundary: Local/static repository hygiene only. No GitHub, branch-protection, Kubernetes, secret, deployment, or live CI/CD state was mutated.

facets.F1_simplicity: One focused gate moved from shell plus embedded Python into one Rust checker plus one Rust test harness; old runnable script files were deleted.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: The Buck2 target uses a small active-surface manifest instead of an unbounded worktree walk or giant Buck2 source environment, preserving stable launch surfaces for parallel lanes.
facets.F3_adversarial: Fixture tests cover allowed connector/platform language and rejected suite/platform/module/product wrapper wording.
facets.F4_api_contract: No product API changed; tenant/RBAC packaging static_gates now point to Buck2 targets.
facets.F5_quality: Rust 2024, rustfmt, -D warnings, JSON validation, diff hygiene, and repo-hygiene checks were run fresh.
facets.F6_operations: The audited Python/shell inventory count now matches the filesystem count of 53 excluding vendored surfaces.
facets.F7_security_privacy: Secret-shape scans over changed files found no credential-shaped tokens; no secrets or live credentials were introduced.
facets.F8_supply_chain: No new dependencies were added; implementation uses the standard library and existing Buck2/rustc genrule pattern.
facets.F9_testing: Verification includes direct Rust tests, Buck2 genrule targets, repo-hygiene, Buck2 authority, language discipline, and Kubernetes anti-pattern checks.
facets.F10_ci_cd: CI authority remains Buck2/Prow/Kubernetes-native; this change removes a local shell/Python advisory gate and adds Buck2 evidence targets.
facets.F11_observability: Buck2 output artifacts report JSON verdicts for the retired-wording and no-grouping checks.
facets.F13_reversibility: Rollback is isolated to restoring two deleted shell files and reverting the new Buck2/Rust targets plus inventory count updates.

verification.command: git diff --check && jq empty changed JSON artifacts
scripts/evidence-secret-scan.sh changed files + regex secret sweep
verification.result: helper PASS across 8 targets; regex sweep had no credential-shape hits

non_claims: No live Prow, GitHub, Kubernetes, branch protection, deployment, or secret state was changed.
No full repository stale-doc archival is claimed by this slice.
No production CI authority cutover is claimed; this is local/static Buck2 evidence only.
remaining_risks: Other Python/shell surfaces remain in the tracked migration backlog.
Draft task/spec documents under docs/specs and tasks still require separate stale-doc archival/rewrite lanes.
